import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from rle.core import encode, decode
# Test cases
tests = [
    ('', ''),
    ('a', 'a1'),
    ('aaabbc', 'a3b2c1'),
    ('abc', 'a1b1c1'),
    ('x'*12, 'x12'),
    ('hello', 'h1e1l2o1'),
]
for inp, expected in tests:
    out = encode(inp)
    if out != expected:
        print(f'FAIL: encode({repr(inp)}) = {repr(out)} expected {repr(expected)}')
        sys.exit(1)
    # round-trip
    if decode(out) != inp:
        print(f'FAIL round-trip: decode(encode({repr(inp)})) = {repr(decode(out))} expected {repr(inp)}')
        sys.exit(1)
print('All manual tests passed')
